name: Witch's Broom
description:
You have learned the art of crafting a witch’s broom.

You may spend 1 hour crafting and enchanting a broom from raw materials. At the end of the hour, the broom becomes magical and attuned to you.

While you are astride the broom, you may fly. Additionally:

  • You may spend 1 MP to double your speed for one turn as a free action.

  • If the broom is within medium range, you may spend 1 MP and a half action to call it to you.

  • You may spend 1 MP to allow the broom to bear a second rider for 1 hour.

You may have only one crafted witch’s broom attuned to you at a time. If you craft and attune to another broom, your previous broom loses its magic and becomes mundane.

Describe your broom.

improvements.name: Borrowed Broom
improvements.description:
You can temporarily attune to a broom you did not craft.

Spend 1 action and maintain concentration for 1 round while holding or touching the broom. At the end of the round, you become temporarily attuned to it for 1 minute. This does not break your attunement to you regular witch's broom.

While this attunement lasts, the broom behaves like your Witch’s Broom, but whenever you fly using the broom, roll a feat die. On a result of:

  • 💀, your attunement immediately ends and the broom becomes mundane. If you are airborne, you fall.

  • 1-3, the broom moves in a random direction, determined by the GM.

  • 4-10, the broom moves as you intend.

  • 🌞, the broom moves as you intend for the rest of the attunement. You no longer roll the feat die each time you fly with the broom.

When the minute ends, the broom becomes mundane. If you are airborne, you fall.
